name: Witch College
source: Witch College is a charming and magical story about a young man who must ask a girl to a Halloween Dance. When a new girl comes to the school, weird things start happening and he suspects she may be an ancient legendary witch who is trying to seduce him.
translation: 女巫学院是一个迷人而神奇的故事，讲述了一个年轻人必须邀请一个女孩参加万圣节舞会的故事。当一个新女孩来到学校时，奇怪的事情开始发生，他怀疑她可能是一个试图引诱他的古代传奇女巫。
